description: MainActivity class for Android TV app, responsible for hosting the HomeFragment, handling key events, navigation, and focus restoration after activities result.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing the app's main screen, hosting HomeFragment, handling key navigation, and focus restoration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and loads HomeFragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events such as ENTER, DPAD_CENTER, and BACK to manage focus and activity lifecycle.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from ContentInfoActivity to restore focus to specific items in the RecyclerViews.

methods.name: restoreFocus
methods.description: Scrolls RecyclerViews to specified positions and triggers focus on a particular item after returning from another activity.
